About Company

Incorporated in 1991, BLS Polymers Limited manufactures multiple grades of custom formulated polymer compounds used across telecommunication, power, railways, water, and oil and gas distribution industries. Its products serve as essential raw materials for sheathing, jacketing and insulation of wires and cables, as well as coating of underground pipelines.

The company's product portfolio includes HDPE, MDPE, LLDPE, XLPE, HFFR, PVC, cable filling compounds and adhesive coating compounds, manufactured across 127 grades. Its single Manufacturing Facility is located in Goa, strategically near Mormugao Port and connected to major national highways.

Key business highlights

  • Enlisted with Maharatna, Navratna and Miniratna CPSEs and the Government of Gujarat for supply of its products
  • Served over 190 customers in Fiscal 2026 across domestic and export markets
  • Operations spread across 23 states/union territories with exports to multiple countries
  • Part of the BLS Group, with group companies listed on NSE and BSE

The company primarily derives revenue from wire and cable compounds, while expanding into industrial pipeline coating products to diversify its revenue base.

BLS Polymers continues to focus on product development, customer diversification and expansion of its manufacturing capacity to strengthen its position in the polymer compounding industry.

Strengths

Government Agency Enlistment: The company's products are enlisted with a Maharatna CPSE power transmission company, a Navratna CPSE engineering consultancy company, a Miniratna CPSE telecommunication company and the Government of Gujarat, affirming technical competence and creating a barrier to entry for new players.

Diversified Product Portfolio: The company manufactures 6 products across 127 grades, serving diverse end-user industries including railways and telecommunication, enabling cross-selling and reducing dependence on any single product category.

Long-Standing Customer Relationships: Over three decades of operations have helped the company build long-standing customer relationships, serving 190 customers in Fiscal 2026 with 72.63% repeat customers contributing 96.51% of revenue from operations.

Risk Factors

Dependence on Wire and Cable Compounds: The company derived 73.20% to 81.59% of its revenue from wire and cable polymer compounds across the periods presented, and any reduction in demand for such products could materially affect its business and financial condition.

Customer Concentration Risk: The top 10 customers contributed between 50.52% and 66.81% of revenue across the periods presented, and loss of any such customers due to business disputes or financial difficulties could materially affect operations.

Risks of International Expansion: The company is expanding into new regions such as Tunisia, Algeria, Nigeria and Oman without prior presence or distributor networks, exposing it to regulatory, tariff and market-entry risks that could delay growth plans.
